subject: MAP kickoff: initial draft, timeline options & confirmation of stakeholders
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nexterahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: initial draft, timeline options & confirmation of stakeholders

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the thoughtful discovery — we captured a lot that will help shape the Mutual Action Plan (MAP). Attached is the initial MAP draft (Nextera_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short checklist of dependencies. Can you confirm the stakeholders below and whether the timelines look realistic?

Quick recap from the call:
- Primary goal: embed Redwood inference for customer-facing triage flows (reduce manual routing by 60% in Q4)
- Key success metrics: 95th latency < 300ms for 2k concurrent sessions; error rate < 1%
- Compliance requirements: SOC 2 + customer-managed KMS for production keys

Proposed MAP (high level) — please scan and let me know changes:
1) Discovery & scoping (this week) — owners: Alex (Nextera), Marissa (Redwood) — deliverable: final requirements doc
2) Pilot config & test (2-4 weeks) — owners: Nextera eng + Redwood infra — deliverable: pilot cluster, test harness, perf baseline
3) Security & procurement (parallel) — owners: Nextera security/procurement, Redwood compliance — deliverable: SOC 2 evidence, KMS integration plan
4) Pilot validation & acceptance (1 week) — owners: Nextera product, Redwood CS — deliverable: acceptance sign-off
5) Prod rollout & handoff (2 weeks) — owners: Nextera ops, Redwood dedicated ops — deliverable: runbook + SLA docs

Target close: mid-August (proposed) — this assumes pilot starts next week. Major dependencies: access to sample data, procurement timelines, and access to Nextera test cloud account.

Timeline options included in the attachment: a 6-week accelerated path and a 10-week conservative path. Please confirm:
- Final decision maker for purchase (name & email)
- Primary technical stakeholder(s) for pilot (name & email)
- Procurement contact (for SOW/contract redlines)

Would you prefer we schedule a dedicated MAP kickoff meeting to walk through the attached and lock owners/timelines? I can send two time options once you confirm stakeholders.

Attachments: Nextera_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/abcd1234/view?usp=sharing

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
